design.name: nl_sat_counter
design.description: Implement an 8-bit unsigned synchronous saturating up/down counter. On every rising edge of clk, apply this priority: (1) if rst_n is low, set count to 0; (2) otherwise if clear is high, set count to 0; (3) otherwise if enable is low, hold count; (4) otherwise if up is high, increment count by 1 only when count is less than 255, otherwise hold 255; (5) otherwise decrement count by 1 only when count is greater than 0, otherwise hold 0. rst_n is a synchronous active-low reset. The outputs at_min and at_max are combinational, with at_min equal to 1 exactly when count is 0 and at_max equal to 1 exactly when count is 255; they add no pipeline latency. Ports are clk (1-bit input), rst_n (1-bit input), clear (1-bit input), enable (1-bit input), up (1-bit input), count (8-bit unsigned output), at_min (1-bit output), and at_max (1-bit output). Do not use initial blocks, delay statements, vendor primitives, file I/O, or SystemVerilog DPI.
